fact: The ministry's review states that the MoDoNum digitised-documents module was updated at the land conservations of Bamako District and Kati cercle, and NINACAD cadastral numbers were assigned to over 1.5 million parcels in Bamako, Kati, Ségou, Koulikoro, Sikasso and other communes.
title: Gestion foncière et domaniale : le bilan des réformes phares de la Transition
